public_rationale: Gizmodo eliminated its Spanish editorial team and substituted automated translations. The replacement output had material language defects, supporting the reading that equivalent performance was not a necessary prerequisite to eliminating positions. This settles the replacement branch of the sentence's 'or'; it does not establish the workload branch or universal employer indifference to capability.
limitations: The assessment treats whole positions at one employer as entire roles.
Observed defects support the capability qualification indirectly; internal testing records were not available.
The evidence is reputable reporting rather than a direct company acknowledgment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Regardless of capability, AI will be used to replace entire roles or to force workers to take on much extra work.
conditions: regardless of how capable it is

statement.excerpt: AI - regardless of how capable it is at any given task - can and will be used to replace entire roles, or force current workers to take on massive amounts of extra work because they’re “enhanced by AI.”

from_speaker: regardless of how capable it is at any given task
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that employers will eliminate whole positions through AI substitution or substantially increase existing workers' assignments by invoking AI productivity.
The word 'or' makes these alternative routes to support; both need not occur.
'Regardless of how capable' is not an antecedent that must happen. It asserts that demonstrated equivalent task quality will not necessarily be required.
For the replacement route, require a completed whole-position substitution and evidence that implementation proceeded despite material capability shortcomings.
Entire roles means whole jobs at the affected employer, not the disappearance of an occupation everywhere.
criteria.support_condition: A documented post-publication employer eliminates whole positions through AI substitution despite material capability shortcomings, or imposes substantially more work on existing staff because of claimed AI assistance without establishing adequate capability.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Decisive evidence rules out both predicted practices. Individual successful deployments or employers protecting jobs cannot disprove this forecast without a deadline.

evidence.locator: First article paragraph; subsequent paragraphs describe language-switching defects and the eliminated team
evidence.explanation: The report establishes whole-team replacement, with the automated output sometimes switching from Spanish into English. That supports implementation despite deficient task performance, though it does not reveal management's testing process or prove indifference to every aspect of quality.

conclusive_event.meets_rule: The completed editorial-team dismissal and automated replacement establish the whole-position route; the report documents capability shortcomings in the replacement output.
